info.name: Va' e vedi
info.plot: Protagonista della dolorosa vicenda è un ragazzo di sedici anni, originario della Bielorussia, che vive la seconda guerra mondiale con lo strazio di un'adolescenza sprecata e la ferma convinzione che chi uccide deve pagare, perché nessuno ha il diritto di togliere la vita a un altro essere umano.

translations.title: Come and See
translations.overview: The invasion of a village in Belarus by German forces sends young Flyora into the forest to join the weary Resistance fighters, against his family's wishes. There he meets a girl, Glasha, who accompanies him back to his village. On returning home, Flyora finds his family and fellow peasants massacred. His continued survival amidst the brutal debris of war becomes increasingly nightmarish, a battle between despair and hope.
1943 год, Великая Отечественная война. Подросток Флёра, откопав карабин среди обрывков колючей проволоки, ржавых пулемётных лент и простреленных касок, отправляется в лес к партизанам.
